en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5600 - Sama'ah narrated from Abu Basir from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:

Indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (as) used to say, "Surely, the One who counted the grains of sand in Alij knows that the shares (of inheritance) do not exceed six if people were to truly understand their proper allocations; they would never surpass six."
